description_en: Queries the information about the endpoint group of a basic GA instance
description_zh: 调用GetBasicEndpointGroup接口查询指定基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-basic-endpoint-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBasicEndpointGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the basic GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the basic GA instance

Description.description_en: The description of the endpoint group
Description.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组描述信息

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组ID

EndpointGroupRegion.description_en: The ID of the region where the endpoint group resides
EndpointGroupRegion.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组所在的地域ID

EndpointSubAddress.description_en:
The secondary address of the endpoint.

This parameter is returned if the endpoint type is ECS, ENI, or NLB.

If the endpoint type is ECS, EndpointSubAddress returns the primary or secondary private IP address of the primary ENI.
If the endpoint type is ENI, EndpointSubAddress returns the primary or secondary private IP address of the secondary ENI.
If the endpoint type is NLB, EndpointSubAddress returns the primary private IP address of the NLB backend server
EndpointSubAddress.description_zh:
终端节点辅助地址。

当终端节点类型为ECS、ENI或NLB时，返回该参数。
当终端节点类型为ECS时，EndpointSubAddress为主网卡的辅助私网IP或主网卡的主私网IP。
当终端节点类型为ENI时，EndpointSubAddress为辅助网卡的辅助私网IP或辅助网卡的主私网IP。
当终端节点类型为NLB时，EndpointSubAddress为NLB后端服务器的主私网IP

EndpointType.description_en:
The type of endpoint. Valid values:

ENI: elastic network interface (ENI).
SLB: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.
ECS: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.
NLB: Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
EndpointType.description_zh:
终端节点类型。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
SLB：阿里云CLB实例。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
NLB：阿里云NLB实例

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group
Name.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组的名称

State.description_en:
The status of the endpoint group. Valid values:

init: being initialized.
active: running as expected.
updating: being updated.
deleting: being deleted
State.description_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组的状态。

init：初始化。

active：正常。

updating：更新中。

deleting：删除中
